brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;half-n at level 0 and piece:0,0,1;half-n at level 1 stacked via snap
bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-half-n-full placed on level 1 upper base
drawer:0#0,0#cut installed on cut face of lower half base (level 0)
7 caps covering all exposed edges: 3 on level 0 (*;30,90,150) and 4 on level 1 (#;270 and *;30,90,150); check_build meshClash clear with no issues

finish.summary: Workbench organizer built as 2-storey stack of half-n bases. Top storey carries a full bin, bottom storey carries a drawer on its cut face, all free edges capped and mesh verified clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
